items.title: Vistra (VST) Is Seen As A Beneficiary Of Rising AI Power Demand
items.summary: Vistra (NYSE:VST) is being highlighted by industry analysts as a key potential beneficiary of SpaceX's aggressive buildout of AI infrastructure in the United States. SpaceX's planned expansion is expected to materially increase US power demand, which could raise the need for electricity infrastructure supplied by companies such as Vistra.
